==Biography==
He started gaming when PC gaming was getting popular in Korea but disliked Starcraft and preferred Fortress, a tank shooting game. After a while he found Warcraft and Chaos which he played for a long time. He found and started playing League of Legends because it was a "foreign" game. He started playing around the time {{ci|Lux}} came out and started playing {{ci|Blitzcrank}}. He didn't really like Blitzcrank that much and moved on to {{ci|Annie}}. He saved up to later buy {{ci|Anivia}}.<ref>[http://lol.teamazubu.com/team-info Azubu Player Site] ''teamazubu.com''</ref>

== Trivia ==
* Attributes the strength of Frost to their closeness as players and friends; liking them to a second family. 
* Believes that the lack of a hierarchy within the team is important as it allows every player to contribute to analysis and game planning.  
* Favorite champions are: {{ci|Anivia}}, {{ci|Cassiopeia}}, <ref>[http://www.thisisgame.com/board/view.php?id=1117376&board=0&category=13735&subcategory=&page=6&best=&searchmode=title&search=&orderby=&token= ''"MiG Frost Team Interview"'']</ref> and {{ci|Lux}}<ref>[http://www.thisisgame.com/board/view.php?id=1294824&board=0&category=13737&subcategory=&page=3&best=&searchmode=title&search=&orderby=&token= ''"LOL Thisisgame.com official Q&A"]</ref>
* Koreans often said "Yeok-ppa-che" regarding his play, which roughly means "As expected, RapidStar is the best". It was said as mockery at first, but after he had shown great {{ci|Lux}} and {{ci|Anivia}} performances on Azubu The Champions Summer 2012 Final against CLG EU; it became a true expression of respect.
* The name RapidStar is represented in the Korean characters, Min(fast, swift), and Seong(Star).
* Popularizes {{ci|Lux}} in competitive League of Legends.
* Bravely chooses {{ci|Anivia}} to against the best {{ci|Anivia}} player [[Froggen]].
* Awarded Best Mid Laner at 2012 Korean e-Sports Awards. <ref>[http://www.inven.co.kr/webzine/news/?site=lol&news=80305 Result of 2012 Korean e-Sports Awards]''inven.com.kr''</ref>
* Retired from active play January 9, 2014.
